body:
Request d7764a2f-a47f-4542-84b6-b1459a144d8b source handoff published: origin/codex/smart-preview-ui c6d05aa3, exact base fa7372b95ad4e54a695adff877e64bde6e5fcdb2. Eight tests in separate tests-first commits 8f98ff26/dbe266b6; production 3a9995f3. All tests UNRUN on B. Source inspection and git diff --check only.

Injected async SmartPreviewController and direct frozen-native adapter; selected engine-backed RAW Build/Discard/Sync, serial per-photo outcomes/progress and cancel after current operation drains. Preference defaults to Use Smart Previews when available. Actual native open route recorded on DevelopController and shown independently of preference; existing AppModel recovery/pending-open registration, stale produced-session cleanup and save reservations retained. Safe clean/missing preview fallback to available Original only; dirty journal, stale/conflict/failed stop unsafe Original routes and native open errors never retry a different source. Source changes release their exact completed save barrier before reopening. Batch holds reservation through native drain. Cached thumbnail/AX badges and selected-state menu; no per-cell native reads, polling or eager catalog-wide build. Results menu bounded to 100 rows with copy-all report.

Native API/bindings are deliberately NOT guessed/generated/edited here. Authored live calls use your frozen five-method API; A must supply implementation/generated bindings before compilation. Need independent source review, Swift 6 compiler, eight model tests and existing recovery tests, actual RAW offline save/relaunch/reconnect/export/source-switch/cancellation GUI. No faster-interactive/lossy-DNG/performance/working-app claim. Native writer admission and atomic dirty-discard enforcement remain required; UI check is not a lock. Status reads uncancellable; native latency unmeasured. Unvisited thumbnails have no cached Smart Preview badge until selection or batch work.

Full exact file map, test list and limits: tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/SMART-PREVIEW-SWIFT-HANDOFF.md on c6d05aa3. Durable wp/B5-16 CODEX-TAKEOVER note updated. SaveAs branch preserved at3ca3e9c9, no Document/SaveAs/Rust/generated/theme/dependency changes. No B builds/tests/apps/benchmarks or heartbeat/writer restart. A alone compiles/validates/merges main.
